what_changes: whenever any row in the table actually bleeds (here, 'ID:123 $1.00' splits), the WHOLE table is re-emitted from `re.findall(r"<tr>.*?</tr>")` alone; a `<caption>` (or any non-row content) sitting outside every `<tr>` is discarded, taking the money token it held with it
what_does_not_change: the row-level bleed repair itself (unchanged from the bleed_reassigned fixture)
semantics_note: MAJOR-1: falsifies the row's original claim that 'no digit deleted -- both values survive, one relocated'; a table-level caption's money value is genuinely destroyed, not merely relocated, whenever the table is rewritten at all
